# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 11 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_011_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 11

**11:1** And she took the water-jar and went out to draw water. And behold, a voice saying, "Hail, highly favored one, the Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women."

**11:2** And she looked to the right and to the left to see where this voice came from. And trembling she went to her house and set down the water-jar and took up the purple and sat down on her seat and drew it out.

**11:3** And behold, an angel of the Lord stood before her and said, "Do not fear, Mary, for you have found grace before the Lord of all things. You shall conceive by his word."

**11:4** And she, hearing, reasoned within herself, saying, "Shall I conceive by the Lord, the living God, and bring forth as every woman brings forth?"

**11:5** And the angel of the Lord said, "Not so, Mary. For the power of the Lord shall overshadow you; wherefore that holy one who shall be born of you shall be called Son of the Most High. And you shall call his name Jesus, for he shall save his people from their sins."

**11:6** And Mary said, "Behold the handmaid of the Lord before him. Let it be to me according to your word."
